conflicts.topic: 2026 KTM 150 XC-W fork spring rate units
conflicts.spread: Printed 40/42/44 N/mm (228.4/239.8/251.2 lbf/in) vs 4.0-5.0 N/mm on every GasGas WP XPLOR fork table in this batch
conflicts.note: Probably a missing decimal point in the manual or the extract (4.0/4.2/4.4 N/mm). Recorded as printed; check against the PDF before showing a spring rate.

conflicts.spread: MC 5-speed printed as 14:28/16:26/18:24/21:24/22:21, the same as the MC 250 two-stroke, whereas the MC 250F lists 13:32/16:32/17:28/19:26/21:25
conflicts.note: Possibly a copy-over error in the manual. Recorded as printed.

conflicts.topic: 2022 GasGas MC 450F Troy Lee Designs fork
conflicts.spread: Fork named 'WP XACT 5448' (art. 34.18.8U.59), but the table gives 10.7 bar air pressure and the AER oil/grease layout

not_found: No fork air-pressure range, step size or per-rider-weight air table appears in any GasGas extract in this batch; only a single standard pressure is given.
2024 GasGas MC 250F Factory Edition shock: the extract ends after rebound comfort (17 clicks). Spring, preload and sag values were not available.
2022 GasGas EX 450F shock: the extract ends after LSC standard (15 clicks). The record is partial.
2026 KTM 150 XC-W individual gear ratios: the heading is present but the ratios are not in the extract.
Skipped models not in garageModels: KTM 125 XC-W (2026), GasGas EC 500F and EW 500F (2024).
Steering head angle, fork offset etc. are not given per variant; values printed once are applied to all models in the manual.
